## Purpose of this vignette

This HTML vignette explains **what each `deseq2reports` module does**, the
functions used inside it, and their **main / default settings**. No figures --
only code and narrative.

For a short “how do I run it?” guide, see
`vignette("deseq2reports", package = "deseq2reports")`.
For calculation / dependency flow diagrams, see
`vignette("deseq2reports-analysis-flow", package = "deseq2reports")`.

```{r}
library(deseq2reports)
library(DESeq2)
# Assume `dds` is a DESeqDataSet with gene-symbol rownames and a grouping
# column such as `condition` in colData(dds).
```

---

## Pipeline orchestration: `run_deseq2_wald()` / `run_deseq2_lrt()` / `run_deseq2_deg()`

**Role.** Chains every stage below into one call and (by default) renders the
multi-page HTML report. Prefer `run_deseq2_wald()` for group contrasts,
`run_deseq2_lrt()` for time / ordered trajectories, and `run_deseq2_deg()`
when starting from a merged DEG table (no `DESeqDataSet`).
`run_deseq2_pipeline()` is a deprecated alias of `run_deseq2_wald()`.

```{r}
out <- run_deseq2_wald(
  dds,
  var = "condition",          # length 1–3
  design = NULL,              # NULL → resolve_design(var, batch, include_interactions)
  include_interactions = FALSE, # TRUE → adds difference-of-differences contrasts
  comparisons = NULL,         # NULL → full pairwise + one-vs-rest grid
  batch = NULL,
  platform = "rnaseq",        # batch correction: "rnaseq" → ComBat-seq,
                              #                   "microarray" → ComBat
  filter_method = "cpm",
  cpm_percentile = 0.05,
  ranking = "log2FoldChange",
  collections = c("HALLMARK", "GOBP", "GOCC", "GOMF",
                  "KEGG", "REACTOME", "PID"),
  n_scree_pcs = 10,
  n_loading_pcs = 6,
  n_top_genes = 10,
  top_label_n = 5,            # volcano labels per direction
  top_n_plot = 10,            # GSEA barplot pathways per NES direction
  # Optional modules (default FALSE):
  run_gsva = FALSE,
  run_wgcna = FALSE,
  run_decoupler_tf = FALSE,
  run_decoupler_ccc = FALSE,
  run_viper = FALSE,
  # Default-on:
  run_cspa = TRUE,
  render_html = TRUE,
  parallel_render = FALSE,    # knit contrast pages in parallel (mclapply, Unix)
  render_workers = NULL,      # NULL → min(4, detectCores() - 1)
  use_targets = FALSE,        # TRUE → render_report_targets() (resumable)
  save_dir = getwd()
)
```

Statistical and plotting thresholds -- LFC shrinkage, `alpha`, the LFC
cutoff, GSVA heatmap size, WGCNA minimum module size, and the hub / TF /
marker counts -- are fixed by the pipeline so runs stay comparable. Call the
module functions below directly to change them.

**Wald stages (in order).** `run_qc()` → `run_distance_pca()` →
`run_diffexp_pipeline()` → `run_cspa_marker_pipeline()` →
`run_gsea_pipeline()` (+ overlap) → optional GSVA / WGCNA / decoupler-tf /
decoupler-ccc / VIPER → `run_multihit_pipeline()` → `render_report()`.
PPI and CSPA run by default.

**LRT entry point.**

```{r}
out <- run_deseq2_lrt(
  dds,
  var = "genotype",             # or NULL for time-only
  time = "day",
  include_interactions = FALSE,
  run_gsva = TRUE,
  run_wgcna = TRUE,
  run_decoupler_tf = TRUE,
  run_decoupler_ccc = TRUE,
  run_viper = TRUE,
  degpatterns_minc = 15,
  save_dir = "results_lrt"
)
```

LRT stages: QC → distance → LRT grid (`run_diffexp_lrt_pipeline()`) →
degPatterns → CSPA-by-cluster → cluster ORA → optional WGCNA →
per-cluster TF (decoupler-tf / VIPER) and optional decoupler-ccc (scored per
test *and* per cluster) → PPI → `run_multihit_lrt_pipeline()` → report.
Ranked GSEA is **not** used in LRT mode.

**Return value.** List with `dds`, `distance`, `diffexp`, `gsea` /
PPI / CSPA (default-on), optional `gsva` / `wgcna` / `decoupler_tf` /
`decoupler_ccc` / `viper`, plus `multihit` and `report_path`. LRT also
returns `degpatterns` / `cluster_ora`.

**Helpers used by the orchestrator.** `resolve_design()`,
`validate_comparisons()` / `expand_contrast_specs()` / `expand_lrt_specs()`,
`detect_organism()`, `log_output()`.

---

## Loading helpers: `load_nfcore()` / `summarize_genes_dds()`

**Role.** Build a gene-symbol-level `DESeqDataSet` from nf-core outputs or
from an object whose `rowData` already carries symbols.

```{r}
# nf-core/rnaseq .RData (object named `dds`) + 3-column tx2gene TSV
dds <- load_nfcore("salmon.merged.gene_counts.RData", "tx2gene.tsv")

# Or collapse an existing object by rowData symbol column
dds <- summarize_genes_dds(dds, gene_sym_col = "gene")
```

`summarize_genes()` sums count rows that share a gene symbol (used
internally by both helpers).

---

## Quality control: `run_qc()`

**Role.** Filter genes, estimate size factors, write QC summaries / plots, and
attach metadata for the report. The HTML **Sample QC** section (before Library
QC) reports per-sample detected genes and total transcripts from the input
count matrix (`qc_sample_summary.csv`).

```{r}
dds_qc <- run_qc(
  dds,
  var = "condition",
  filter_method = "cpm",          # "cpm" | "count" | NULL
  cpm_percentile = 0.05,          # used when filter_method = "cpm"
  min_count = 10,                 # used when filter_method = "count"
  min_samples_per_group = NULL,   # NULL → size of smallest group
  remove_mt = FALSE,
  mt_pattern = "^MT-|^mt-",
  remove_xy = FALSE,
  gene_chr = NULL,                # needed if remove_xy = TRUE
  remove_vdj = NULL,              # NULL/FALSE | TRUE/"both" | "BCR" | "TCR"
  save_dir = getwd(),
  save_plot = TRUE
)
```

**Supporting functions (defaults).**

| Function | Defaults / role |
|---|---|
| `plot_library_size(dds, var)` | Per-sample library sizes by group |
| `plot_count_distribution(...)` | Pre/post filter density; cutoff line |
| `detect_organism(genes, min_fraction = 0.5)` | `"human"` / `"mouse"` from symbols |

**Return value.** Filtered `DESeqDataSet`; QC metadata in
`S4Vectors::metadata(dds_qc)$deseq2reports_qc` (includes
`sample_qc_table`, `steps_summary`, and diagnostic plots).

---

## Sample distance / PCA: `run_distance_pca()`

**Role.** VST (or rlog), PCA, scree, top loadings, sample-similarity heatmap,
and a **PC–covariate association** heatmap for the leading PCs vs `batch` /
grouping factors / `time` (when passed via `assoc_vars`); optional
visualization-only batch correction.

```{r}
distance_out <- run_distance_pca(
  dds_qc,
  var = "condition",
  batch = NULL,
  platform = "rnaseq",        # "rnaseq" → ComBat-seq | "microarray" → ComBat
  transform = "vst",          # or "rlog"
  pals = NULL,
  shape_var = NULL,
  ntop = 500,                 # most-variable genes for PCA
  n_scree_pcs = 10,
  n_loading_pcs = 6,
  n_top_genes = 10,           # genes labelled per PC in loadings plot
  assoc_vars = NULL,          # NULL → unique(c(var, batch)); LRT runners pass time too
  n_assoc_pcs = 15,           # PCs in the covariate association heatmap
  save_dir = getwd(),
  save_plot = TRUE
)
```

**Supporting functions (defaults).**

| Function | Defaults / role |
|---|---|
| `plot_pca(pca_df, var, shape_var = NULL, pals = NULL)` | PC1 vs PC2 scatter |
| `plot_pca_scree(..., n_scree_pcs = 10)` | % variance per PC |
| `plot_pca_top_loadings(..., n_loading_pcs = 6, n_top_genes = 10)` | Top loading genes |
| `pca_covariate_association(pca_df, assoc_vars, n_pcs = 15)` | PC × covariate p-values |
| `plot_pca_covariate_heatmap(assoc_df)` | −log₁₀(p) association heatmap |
| `plot_sample_similarity(...)` | Spearman sample×sample heatmap |
| `compute_pca_loadings(...)` / `top_genes_per_pc(...)` | Loading tables |
| `make_interactive(gg, tooltip = "text", square = TRUE, base_size = 550)` | plotly widget |

Batch correction (when `batch` is set) is for **plots only** -- not the DE
model (`~ batch + var` / `~ batch + time` is used for DEG instead). Corrected
and uncorrected PCA panels **and** PC–covariate association heatmaps are both
returned.

---

## Differential expression: `run_diffexp_pipeline()` / `run_diffexp()`

**Role.** Fit DESeq2, run contrasts, shrink LFCs, rank genes, write tables and
MA/volcano plots.

```{r}
diffexp_out <- run_diffexp_pipeline(
  dds_qc,
  var = "condition",
  comparisons = NULL,         # NULL → generate_comparisons() / expand_contrast_specs()
  batch = NULL,               # added to design when set
  include_interactions = FALSE, # two-/three-factor: interaction contrasts when TRUE
  shrinkage = "ashr",         # "ashr" | "apeglm" | "normal" | "none"
  alpha = 0.05,
  lfc_threshold = 0.5,
  ranking = "log2FoldChange",           # "pxfc" | "padj" | "log2FoldChange" | "stat"
  gene_col = "gene",
  top_label_n = 10,           # pipeline wrapper uses 5 when called via run_deseq2_wald()
  save_dir = getwd(),
  save_plot = TRUE
)
```

**Supporting functions (defaults).**

| Function | Defaults / role |
|---|---|
| `run_diffexp(dds, contrast, shrinkage = "ashr", ...)` | Single-contrast fit |
| `generate_comparisons(levels)` | All pairwise + one-vs-rest labels |
| `expand_contrast_specs(dds, var, include_interactions = FALSE)` | Main-effect specs per factor; `TRUE` adds difference-of-differences interaction specs (one-vs-rest for factors with 3+ levels) |
| `classify_comparison_type(labels)` | `"pairwise"` vs `"one_vs_all"` |
| `assert_full_rank_model_matrix(mm)` | Fail early on singular designs |
| `compute_ranking_score(res, ranking = "log2FoldChange")` | Gene ranking metric |
| `plot_ma(res, alpha = 0.05, lfc_threshold = 0.5)` | MA plot |
| `plot_volcano(res, alpha = 0.05, lfc_threshold = 0.5, top_label_n = 5)` | Volcano |
| `diffexp_top_bottom_table(res, top_n = 10)` | Top up/down table helper |
| `make_deg_datatable(res, digits = 4, page_length = 10)` | Interactive DEG table |

**Significance.** `sig` requires `padj < alpha` **and**
`|log2FoldChange| > lfc_threshold`.

**Return value.** `results`, `by_comparison`, `contrast_specs`.

---

## Pathway enrichment (GSEA): `run_gsea_pipeline()`

**Role.** Rank genes per contrast; run `fgsea` for each MSigDB collection;
write CSVs, NES barplots, and barcode panels.

```{r}
gsea_out <- run_gsea_pipeline(
  diffexp_out$results,
  collections = "HALLMARK",   # pipeline default is broader (see above)
  ranking = "log2FoldChange",
  gene_col = "gene",
  min_size = 15,
  max_size = 500,
  top_n_plot = 10,            # pathways per NES direction in barplot/barcode
  save_dir = getwd(),
  save_plot = TRUE,
  run_clusterprofiler = FALSE
)
```

**Supporting functions (defaults).**

| Function | Defaults / role |
|---|---|
| `detect_organism(genes, min_fraction = 0.5)` | Species for MSigDB |
| `import_msigdbr(org, collection)` | Named gene-set list |
| `import_msigdbr_term2gene(org, collection)` | For clusterProfiler path |
| `build_gsea_ranks(res, gene_col = "gene", ranking = "log2FoldChange")` | Named rank vector |
| `run_gsea(ranks, gene_sets, min_size = 15, max_size = 500, eps = 1e-10)` | `fgsea` wrapper |
| `run_clusterprofiler_gsea(ranks, term2gene, min_size = 15, max_size = 500)` | Optional |
| `plot_gsea_barplot(res, top_n = 10, signif_only = FALSE)` | NES barplot |
| `plot_gsea_barcode_panel(res, ranks, gene_sets, top_n = 10, signif_only = FALSE)` | NES-coloured barcodes |
| `gsea_top_bottom_table(res, top_n = 10)` | Top/bottom NES table |
| `make_gsea_datatable(res, digits = 4, page_length = 10)` | Interactive table |

**Barcode colouring.** One track per pathway; red = `NES > 0`, blue =
`NES < 0` (not per-gene up/down).

**Return value.** `results`, `by_comparison`, `ranks_by_comparison`,
`gene_sets`, `ranking`, `org`.

---

## GSEA leading-edge overlap: `run_gsea_overlap_pipeline()`

**Role.** Pool significant pathways (`padj < alpha`) across collections per
contrast; Jaccard similarity of leading-edge gene sets; `binary_cut`
clustering with a no-label heatmap and side word clouds
(`simplifyEnrichment`, imported with the package). Shown at the bottom of
the **clusterProfiler** HTML page.

```{r}
gsea_overlap_out <- run_gsea_overlap_pipeline(
  gsea_out, alpha = 0.05,
  save_dir = "results/clusterprofiler"  # → <comp>/gsea_overlap/
)
```

---

## Sample-level pathway scores (GSVA): `run_gsva_pipeline()`

**Role.** Score every gene set in each sample rather than testing a ranked
contrast, so pathways can be compared sample by sample on the **GSVA** HTML
page. Independent of the GSEA module above.

```{r}
gsva_out <- run_gsva_pipeline(
  dds_qc,
  var = "condition",
  collections = c("HALLMARK", "GOBP", "GOCC", "GOMF",
                  "KEGG", "REACTOME", "PID"),
  n_heatmap = 50,             # heatmap rows for non-HALLMARK collections
  min_size = 10,              # min overlapping genes per set
  gene_sets = NULL,           # supply to bypass msigdbr (tests)
  batch = NULL,
  platform = "rnaseq",        # ComBat-seq (or ComBat) when batch is set
  save_dir = "results/gsva",
  save_plot = TRUE
)
```

**Supporting functions (defaults).**

| Function | Defaults / role |
|---|---|
| `plot_gsva_heatmap(scores, group, var_label = "group", keep = NULL, collection = NULL)` | Row-scaled sample × pathway heatmap |

Scores come from blind VST (batch-corrected first when `batch` is set). Every
collection is scored in full to CSV; HALLMARK is heatmapped in full, while the
large collections are heatmapped as the top `n_heatmap` pathways by
Kruskal–Wallis association with `var` -- a GSEA-style `padj` cutoff does not
apply here, since every set gets a score.

**Return value.** `org`, `collections`, `scores` (pathway × sample matrices),
`stats` (ranking tables), `heatmaps`, `n_heatmap`, `min_size`, `var`.

**Requires.** Import `GSVA`.

---

## Cross-analysis gene hits: `run_multihit_pipeline()` / `run_multihit_lrt_pipeline()`

**Role (Wald).** Per contrast, rank genes by hit count across DEG, GSEA
leading edges (at most +1), VIPER, decoupleR, and CSPA; top-10 stacked
barplots on the dedicated **Multihit** HTML page (`multihit/multihit.html`,
after VIPER in the nav).

```{r}
multihit_out <- run_multihit_pipeline(
  diffexp_out, gsea_out = gsea_out,
  viper_out = viper_out, decoupler_tf_out = decoupler_tf_out,
  cspa_out = cspa_out,
  top_n = 10, save_dir = "results/multihit"
)
```

**Role (LRT).** Per degPatterns cluster, top-10 table of genes co-occurring
across LRT DEG membership, WGCNA modules, decoupleR TFs, and VIPER TFs
(`run_multihit_lrt_pipeline()`), also on the Multihit page.

---

## WGCNA: `run_wgcna_pipeline()`

**Role.** Soft-threshold selection, signed modules, module–trait correlation,
hub genes (kME), per-module ORA.

```{r}
wgcna_out <- run_wgcna_pipeline(
  dds_qc,
  var = "condition",
  power = NULL,                             # NULL → auto-select
  power_vector = c(1:10, seq(12, 20, 2)),
  rsq_cutoff = 0.85,
  network_type = "signed",
  min_module_size = 30,
  merge_cut_height = 0.25,
  max_modules = 15L,                        # merge toward ≤ this many modules
  cor_type = "pearson",
  top_n_hub_genes = 10,
  ora_collection = c("GOBP", "GOCC", "GOMF",
                     "KEGG", "REACTOME", "PID"),
  top_n_ora = 10,
  gene_col = "gene",
  save_dir = getwd(),
  save_plot = TRUE
)
```

**Supporting functions (defaults).**

| Function | Defaults / role |
|---|---|
| `plot_soft_threshold(fit_indices)` | Scale-free topology / mean connectivity |
| `plot_module_sizes(module_df)` | Genes per module |
| `plot_module_trait_heatmap(module_trait_cor)` | Module vs trait correlation |
| `plot_module_eigengene_heatmap(MEs)` | Sample × ME heatmap |
| `plot_module_ora_dotplot(ora_df, top_n = 10)` | Per-module ORA dots |

Modules are renamed `"Module 1"`, `"Module 2"`, … by size; WGCNA grey →
`"Unassigned"` (excluded from ORA). HTML module-gene tables list **all**
members by `|kME|` (top 10 rows shown by default).

**Requires.** Imports `WGCNA`, `withr` (installed with the package).

---

## TF activity (CollecTRI + ULM): `run_decoupler_tf_pipeline()`

**Role.** Sample- and contrast-level TF activities via decoupleR ULM on
CollecTRI.

```{r}
decoupler_tf_out <- run_decoupler_tf_pipeline(
  dds_qc,
  var = "condition",
  diffexp_out = diffexp_out,
  n_tfs = 25,                 # TFs in contrast barplots
  n_tfs_heatmap = 50,         # most variable TFs in sample heatmap
  minsize = 5,                # min targets per TF for run_ulm
  gene_col = "gene",
  save_dir = getwd(),
  save_plot = TRUE
)
```

**Supporting functions (defaults).**

| Function | Defaults / role |
|---|---|
| `plot_tf_sample_heatmap(sample_acts, n_tfs = 50)` | Sample × TF heatmap |
| `plot_tf_contrast_barplot(acts, n_tfs = 25, title = NULL)` | Contrast TF barplot |

Sample scores use blind VST; contrast scores use DESeq2 Wald `stat`
(or LRT cluster `stat` when `diffexp_out` comes from
`lrt_clusters_diffexp_for_tf()`). Prefer a local CollecTRI CSV under
`inst/extdata/collectri_{human,mouse}_*.csv` (GitHub package default) or pass `collectri_file=`.

**Requires.** Imports `decoupleR` (`OmnipathR` only used if no local network).

---

## Ligand–receptor activity (cell–cell communication): `run_decoupler_ccc_pipeline()`

**Role.** Score LIANA-style ligand–receptor pairs as a decoupleR network
(`source` = the pair, `target` = its ligand or receptor gene, `mor = 1`) with
ULM on each contrast's `stat` vector, on the **decoupleR-CCC** page. Separate
module from CollecTRI TF activity above.

```{r}
decoupler_ccc_out <- run_decoupler_ccc_pipeline(
  diffexp_out = diffexp_out,
  cluster_diffexp = NULL,     # or lrt_clusters_diffexp_for_tf() output (LRT)
  n_lr = 10,                  # top pairs per direction in the barplot
  minsize = 2,                # a ligand and a receptor
  gene_col = "gene",
  lr_file = NULL,             # local CSV (source, target, mor)
  lr_net = NULL,              # pre-built network; skips any fetch (tests)
  save_dir = "results/decoupler-ccc",
  save_plot = TRUE
)
```

**Supporting functions (defaults).**

| Function | Defaults / role |
|---|---|
| `plot_lr_contrast_barplot(contrast_acts, n_lr = 10, title = NULL)` | Top 10 up / 10 down pairs per comparison |

The L–R resource is resolved in order: local `lr_file` CSV, then `liana`'s
Consensus resource if that package is installed, then OmniPath
ligand–receptor-extra interactions. Whatever is used is written out as
`liana_lr_network.csv`.

**LRT clusters.** Passing `cluster_diffexp` (the same
`lrt_clusters_diffexp_for_tf()` object decoupler-tf and VIPER consume) runs one
extra ULM per degPatterns cluster into `<lrt>/cluster_<n>/`. Because a cluster
signature holds only that cluster's genes, `minsize = 2` means a pair surfaces
for a cluster only when **both** partners are members of it -- which is the
attribution the whole-test fit cannot make, and also why a cluster may
legitimately score no pair at all. `run_deseq2_lrt()` passes it automatically,
and the report then shows one tab per cluster with the pooled whole-test table
kept below.

**Return value.** `org`, `net`, `contrast_acts`, `contrast_barplots`, `n_lr`,
`minsize`, plus `cluster_acts` / `cluster_barplots` / `clusters_by_test` when
`cluster_diffexp` was supplied.

**Requires.** Import `decoupleR`; `liana` (Suggests) or `OmnipathR` for the
network unless `lr_file` / `lr_net` is given.

---

## VIPER (bcellViper): `run_viper_pipeline()`

**Role.** Sample-level `viper()` and contrast-level `msviper()` with the human
B-cell regulon from `bcellViper`.

```{r}
viper_out <- run_viper_pipeline(
  dds_qc,
  var = "condition",
  diffexp_out = diffexp_out,
  n_tfs = 10,                 # master regulators in barcode plots
  n_tfs_heatmap = 50,
  minsize = 25,               # auto-lowered to 15 for mouse if left at default
  gene_col = "gene",
  save_dir = getwd(),
  save_plot = TRUE
)
```

**Supporting functions (defaults).**

| Function | Defaults / role |
|---|---|
| `plot_viper_sample_heatmap(sample_acts, n_tfs = 50)` | Sample × TF heatmap |
| `emit_msviper_plot(msv, filename, mrs = 10, width = 4, height = 2.5, dpi = 150)` | HTML barcode + PDF |

Mouse genes are mapped to human orthologs with `babelgene` before scoring.

**Requires.** Imports `viper`, `bcellViper`, and (mouse) `babelgene`.

---

## STRING PPI connectivity: `run_ppi_pipeline()`

**Role.** STRING subgraphs for DE contrasts and (optionally) WGCNA modules;
BioNERO-style communities / hubs.

```{r}
ppi_out <- run_ppi_pipeline(
  diffexp_out = diffexp_out,
  wgcna_out = NULL,             # or wgcna_out for module networks
  org = NULL,                   # NULL → detect_organism()
  top_n_hubs = 10L,
  max_genes = Inf,              # all sig DEGs / module members as seeds
  max_plot_nodes = 100L,        # degree cap for the plotted network
  score_threshold = 400L,       # STRING combined score (0–1000)
  gene_col = "gene",
  alpha = 0.05,                 # DE direction annotation only
  lfc_threshold = 0.5,
  save_dir = "results/deseq2",
  module_save_dir = "results/ppi",
  wgcna_module_save_dir = "results/wgcna",
  save_plot = TRUE
)
```

**Supporting functions (defaults).**

| Function | Defaults / role |
|---|---|
| `plot_ppi_connectivity(nodes, edges, top_n_hubs = 10L)` | Static network |
| `make_interactive_ppi(nodes, edges = NULL, top_n_hubs = 10L)` | Hoverable plotly |

**Funnel.** seeds → STRING-mapped → genes with ≥1 edge → plot may keep top
`max_plot_nodes` by degree. Degree **tables** keep all genes with edges (HTML
shows top 10 by default).

**Requires.** Imports `STRINGdb`, `igraph`. Embedded in DE / WGCNA pages (no
separate nav page).

---

## HTML report: `render_report()`

**Role.** Knit bundled Rmds into a multi-page, folder-bundled report tree.

```{r}
render_report(
  dds = dds_qc,
  var = "condition",
  distance_out = distance_out,
  diffexp_out = diffexp_out,
  gsea_out = gsea_out,
  gsea_overlap_out = NULL,
  multihit_out = NULL,
  wgcna_out = NULL,
  decoupler_tf_out = NULL,
  ppi_out = NULL,
  viper_out = NULL,
  cspa_out = NULL,
  gsva_out = NULL,
  decoupler_ccc_out = NULL,
  degpatterns_out = NULL,       # LRT: clusters and their plots
  cluster_ora_out = NULL,       # LRT: per-cluster ORA
  alpha = 0.05,
  lfc_threshold = 0.5,
  run_args = NULL,              # optional list shown on the index page
  save_dir = getwd(),
  parallel_render = FALSE,      # knit contrast pages across render_workers
  render_workers = NULL,        # NULL → min(4, detectCores() - 1)
  contrasts_only = FALSE        # skip hub pages (used by render_report_targets)
)
```

**Pages.** `index.html`, `qc/qc.html`, `deseq2/deseq2.html` (+ per-contrast
pages), `clusterprofiler/clusterprofiler.html` (+ per-contrast), optional
`wgcna/`, `decoupler-tf/`, `decoupler-ccc/`, `viper/`, `multihit/`. Missing optional modules are
greyed out in the nav. Pass `dds = NULL` to skip / grey out QC (DEG-table
pipeline).

**Speed and resumability.** With `parallel_render = TRUE` the per-contrast
pages are knitted concurrently through `parallel::mclapply()`; each worker gets its
own `intermediates_dir`, and a page whose pandoc step dies in a worker is
retried once alone in the main session before it is given up as a gap in the
report. `render_report_targets()` is a drop-in alternative that makes each hub
page a **targets** target, so re-rendering skips the pages whose inputs have not
changed and contrast pages follow via `contrasts_only = TRUE`; the entry points
reach it through `use_targets = TRUE`.

**Portability.** Pages are folder-bundled (`self_contained = FALSE`): assets go
to a `lib/` beside each page, figures to `<page>_figures/`, and every nav link,
figure and CSV/PDF download is a relative path. The results tree can therefore
be moved, copied or archived and still opened offline, as long as it moves as a
whole.

**Hub summaries.** DESeq2 and clusterProfiler hubs include
`summarize_deg_contrasts()` / `summarize_gsea_contrasts()` tables (n and %
significant up/down). Multi-factor contrasts are grouped by
`emit_contrast_nav()` under "Main effects" and "Interactions (difference of
differences)" headings, and the DESeq2 hub adds an
`interaction_question_table()` stating each interaction as a question with the
meaning of a positive `log2FoldChange`.

**Supporting functions (defaults).**

| Function | Defaults / role |
|---|---|
| `render_index_page(...)` / `render_qc_page(...)` / … / `render_multihit_page(...)` | Single-page knitters |
| `render_report_targets(..., parallel_render = TRUE, script_path = NULL)` | Resumable render via **targets** |
| `report_page_hrefs(from = "Index")` | Relative href map |
| `report_nav_links(current, disabled = character(0), hrefs = NULL)` | Top nav bar |
| `summarize_deg_contrasts(diffexp_out, ...)` / `summarize_gsea_contrasts(...)` | Hub summary tables |
| `contrast_file_stem(label)` | Basename for nested contrast file prefixes |
| `emit_code_block(..., lang = "r", caption = NULL)` | Minimal reproduce-me code |
| `emit_plot_with_download(plot, filename, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 150)` | Figure + PDF button |
| `emit_heatmap_with_download(heatmap, filename, scale = 1, cell_width = 0.28, cell_height = 0.16)` | `pheatmap` + PDF, sized by `gtable_page_size()` |
| `gtable_page_size(drawable, max_width = 12, max_height = 24)` | Page inches from a gtable's own content (avoids clipped heatmaps) |
| `figure_img_tag(draw, px_width, px_height, pixelratio = 2)` | Rasterize into `<page>_figures/` and link it (`capture_plot_tag()` wraps it) |
| `batch_correction_label(...)` / `expr_correction_label(...)` | `"ComBat-seq"` / `"ComBat-seq then VST"` prose for section text |
| `download_table_button(...)` / `download_plot_button(...)` / `link_output_file(...)` | Offline downloads / on-disk CSV links |
| `make_interactive(...)` / `make_interactive_ppi(...)` | Interactive widgets |

Each report section shows the **minimal package module call** to reproduce it.

## Cross-cutting utilities

| Function | Defaults / role |
|---|---|
| `detect_organism(genes, min_fraction = 0.5)` | `"human"` / `"mouse"` |
| `resolve_design(var, batch = NULL, design = NULL, include_interactions = FALSE)` | Auto design formula |
| `generate_comparisons(levels)` | Pairwise + one-vs-rest labels |
| `expand_contrast_specs(dds, var, include_interactions = FALSE)` | Contrast inventory (1–3 factors; main effects by default, difference-of-differences labels when interactions are on, one-vs-rest for factors with 3+ levels) |
| `contrast_file_stem(label)` | Basename of nested contrast keys |
| `compute_ranking_score(res, ranking = "log2FoldChange")` | Ranking metric |
| `build_gsea_ranks(res, gene_col = "gene", ranking = "log2FoldChange")` | Named ranks |
| `import_msigdbr(org, collection)` | MSigDB gene sets |
| `save_ggplot(plot, path, width = 7, height = 5)` | PDF writer |
| `write_output(x, path, format = "csv")` | Table writer |
| `log_output(call, save_dir, ...)` | Run log + JSON |

## Minimal modular script

```{r}
library(deseq2reports)
library(DESeq2)

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = coldata, design = ~condition)
dds_qc <- run_qc(dds, var = "condition")                 # filter_method = "cpm"
distance_out <- run_distance_pca(dds_qc, var = "condition")
diffexp_out <- run_diffexp_pipeline(dds_qc, var = "condition")
gsea_out <- run_gsea_pipeline(diffexp_out$results)       # collections = "HALLMARK"

# Optional:
# wgcna_out <- run_wgcna_pipeline(dds_qc, var = "condition")
# decoupler_tf_out <- run_decoupler_tf_pipeline(dds_qc, var = "condition", diffexp_out = diffexp_out)
# viper_out <- run_viper_pipeline(dds_qc, var = "condition", diffexp_out = diffexp_out)
# ppi_out <- run_ppi_pipeline(diffexp_out = diffexp_out)

render_report(
  dds_qc, var = "condition",
  distance_out = distance_out,
  diffexp_out = diffexp_out,
  gsea_out = gsea_out,
  save_dir = "results"
)
```

Or:

```{r}
out <- run_deseq2_wald(dds, var = "condition", save_dir = "results")
```
